answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a proof-of-stake (PoS) mechanism to resist Sybil attacks. At dawn of a new epoch, validators are selected based on their stake, creating a haven for honest agents. An attacker attempting to create multiple identities would need to invest in a large amount of stake, making it costly. Even a zephyr of manipulation would be deterred by the economic burden of acquiring and maintaining multiple stakes.
